{{Quote|The ''stars...!'' They're gone! W-we're ''beyond'' the galaxy... lost somewhere in the ''void''!|Leia Organa|<ref name="Star Wars (1977) 38">[[Star Wars (1977) 38|''Star Wars'' (1977) 38]]</ref>}}
The '''Intergalactic Void''', known simply as the '''void''', was the [[Realspace/Legends|space]] between [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxies]].

==History==
{{Quote|We are from another galaxy, Jedi Horn. We crossed the starless night for age upon age.|[[Nom Anor|Yu'shaa]]|<ref name="The New Jedi Order: The Final Prophecy">''[[The New Jedi Order: The Final Prophecy]]''</ref>}}
The [[Yuuzhan Vong]]'s [[Yuuzhan Vong fleet|worldship convoy]] crossed the void to leave [[Yuuzhan Vong galaxy|their galaxy]] and come to the [[The galaxy/Legends|known one]]. Because the [[dovin basal]]s could not properly lock onto any point in the galaxy, the Yuuzhan Vong were forced to travel at sublight speed. This journey lasted several millennia. It was in the void that the Yuuzhan Vong nearly destroyed themselves, as lack of resources caused several [[Koros-Strohna|worldships]] to die, while [[Domain]] and [[Yuuzhan Vong castes|Caste]] competition were taken to the extreme.

The void was also the home of the being [[Ship (sentient spacecraft)|''Ship'']].
